# Provider CLIs from a Docker-built image, mounted as a volume; no more host CLI copy

## What to build

Today graph-manager copies `claude`, `codex`, `opencode` and `qwen` from its own PATH into the sandbox tools folder (`/opt/gm-tools/lib/<cli>` with wrappers in `/opt/gm-tools/bin`). On macOS those are Mach-O binaries, and a sandbox fails with `exec: /opt/gm-tools/bin/../lib/claude/2.1.319: Exec format error`. This slice replaces the copy: graph-manager builds a small image `gm-sandbox-clis:<graph-manager version>` with `npm install -g` inside Docker (so npm picks Linux builds for the daemon's CPU), fills a named volume `gm-clis-<first 12 hex of the image id>` from it, and mounts that volume read-only at `/opt/gm-clis` in every sandbox. The build runs in the background: `GET /api/sandbox/status` reports `building: true` (and `available: false`) until it is done, and a sandboxed start during a build answers 409. A sandbox's PATH becomes `/opt/gm-tools/bin:/opt/gm-clis/bin:` + the PATH of the sandbox's image (from image inspect). Spec: `docs/prd/sandbox-image.md` (sections "Decisions", "Images", "Builder state", "Tools folder"). The recipe-built sandbox image, the settings and rebuild routes and the UI are other slices: here the default sandbox image stays what `defaultImage()` returns today.

The Docker client already has (from an earlier slice): `buildImage(tag, contextTar, { nocache?, labels?, onLine? })`, `inspectImage(name) → { Id, Config?: { Env? } } | undefined`, `listImages(label)`, `removeImage(nameOrId)` (404/409 not errors), `createVolume(name, labels?)`, `inspectVolume(name)`, `listVolumes(label)`, `removeVolume(name)` (404/409 not errors), `createContainer`, `startContainer`, `waitContainer`, `removeContainer`. The fake Docker (`scripts/fake-docker.mjs`) supports `POST /build` (records `fake.builds[]` = `{ tag, nocache, labels, dockerfile }`, fails when the Dockerfile contains `FAKE_BUILD_FAIL`, `--build-delay <ms>` / option `buildDelayMs`), image inspect with `Config.Env`, and passive containers with `Cmd: ["true"]` exit 0 at once.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `docs/prd/sandbox-image.md` — the spec.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox.ts` (470 lines) — `Sandboxes`: `init()` / `status()` (lines ~108–137, `RETRY_MS` 10 s re-init of an unavailable status), `defaultImage()` (~140), `toolsDir()` / `toolsMount()` (~145–155), `start()` (~163–290: image pull, `const tools = this.toolsMount()`, `sandboxEnv(...)`, `mounts = [workspaceMount(...), tools]`, `containerBody(...)`), `prepareTools()` (~405–435, calls `fillTools` with `pathEnv`), `doInit()` (~437–470: ping, self-inspect, network, `prepareTools`, `reconcile`, returns `{ available: true, defaultImage }`). `GM_VERSION` constant (line ~44). `SandboxStatus` interface (~29).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-tools.ts` (230 lines) — `PROVIDER_CLIS`, `findOnPath`, `packageRootOf`, `isBroadDir`, `execLine`, `copyProviderClis` (lines ~120–195) to remove; `fillTools` (~197–230) calls `copyProviderClis(next, opts.pathEnv …)` and swaps in `["graph-execution", "bin", "lib"]`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-run.ts` — `SANDBOX_PATH` (line 24), `sandboxEnv(base, p)` (lines ~145–172, pushes `PATH=${SANDBOX_PATH}`), `containerBody` (~228–264).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (lines ~112–127) and `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.ts` (lines ~105–125) — both already answer `err.status` for a `SandboxError`, so a `SandboxError(409, …)` from `start()` reaches the client as 409.
- Tests that stub the tools step and must also stub the new image step: `src/server/sandbox.test.ts` (class `NoTools`, lines ~36–45; status equality at ~59 and ~73), `src/server/routes/sandbox.test.ts` (line ~16), `src/server/routes/runs.sandbox.test.ts` (lines ~42–49, mounts expectation ~80–83), `src/server/routes/internal.test.ts` (~54–60), `src/server/routes/resume.test.ts` (~68–74), `src/server/sandbox-tools.test.ts` (describe "copyProviderClis" ~68–98 to delete; describe "Sandboxes tools" ~100–165 builds `new Sandboxes({ config, store, pathEnv: "" })`), `src/server/sandbox-run.test.ts` (line ~48 expects `PATH=/opt/gm-tools/bin:/usr/local/sbin:…`), `src/server/sandbox.docker.test.ts` (real Docker, skipped without a daemon) and `src/server/sandbox.e2e.test.ts` (Linux only, exec-mode fake).

## Patterns to follow

**Test seam** — tests replace a protected step with a spy; mirror it for the image step:
```ts
vi.spyOn(Sandboxes.prototype as unknown as { prepareTools: () => Promise<string | undefined> }, "prepareTools").mockImplementation(async function (
  this: { mount?: ToolsMount },
) {
  this.mount = { Type: "bind", Source: "/tmp/gm-tools", Target: "/opt/gm-tools", ReadOnly: true };
  return undefined;
});
```

**init() memoisation** (sandbox.ts): `init()` keeps one `pending` promise and stores `this.last = { status, at }`; `status()` returns `pending`, or re-inits when never run or unavailable for more than `RETRY_MS`.

**Errors to the client**: `throw new SandboxError(409, "…")`; messages are lower-case sentences without a final period.

**Mounts**: `{ Type: "volume", Source: <volume name>, Target: <path>, ReadOnly: true }` (the `ToolsMount` shape).

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-image.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** a header comment (what the module is: the images graph-manager builds for sandboxes). Export:
  - `CLI_IMAGE_REPO = "gm-sandbox-clis"`, `CLIS_TARGET = "/opt/gm-clis"`, `IMAGE_LABEL = "gm.sandbox-image"` (label on every image graph-manager builds, value `"1"`), `CLIS_LABEL = "gm.clis"` (label on the volumes, value `"1"`), `CLI_PACKAGES = ["@anthropic-ai/claude-code", "@openai/codex", "opencode-ai", "@qwen-code/qwen-code"]`.
  - `cliDockerfile(): string` returning exactly:
    ```
    FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm-slim
    RUN npm install -g --prefix /opt/gm-clis --no-audit --no-fund @anthropic-ai/claude-code @openai/codex opencode-ai @qwen-code/qwen-code \
     && /opt/gm-clis/bin/claude --version && /opt/gm-clis/bin/codex --version
    ```
  - `cliImageTag(gmVersion: string) = \`${CLI_IMAGE_REPO}:${gmVersion}\``.
  - `clisVolumeName(imageId: string) = \`gm-clis-${imageId.replace(/^sha256:/, "").slice(0, 12)}\``.
  - `dockerContext(dockerfile: string): Buffer` = `tarArchive([{ path: "Dockerfile", content: Buffer.from(dockerfile) }], { uid: 0, gid: 0 })` (import from `./tar.js`).
  - `async function ensureCliImage(docker: DockerClient, gmVersion: string, opts: { force?: boolean; onLine?: (l: string) => void }): Promise<{ tag: string; id: string }>` — when `force` or `inspectImage(tag)` is undefined: `buildImage(tag, dockerContext(cliDockerfile()), { nocache: !!force, labels: { [IMAGE_LABEL]: "1" }, onLine })`. Then return the tag and `inspectImage(tag).Id` (throw `Error("the CLI image was built but cannot be inspected")` if missing).
  - `async function ensureClisVolume(docker: DockerClient, image: { tag: string; id: string }): Promise<string>` — `name = clisVolumeName(image.id)`; if `inspectVolume(name)` exists return it. Else `createVolume(name, { [CLIS_LABEL]: "1" })`, then create a container named `gm-clis-fill-<8 hex>` with `{ Image: image.tag, Cmd: ["true"], Labels: { "gm.clis-fill": "1" }, HostConfig: { Mounts: [{ Type: "volume", Source: name, Target: CLIS_TARGET }] } }`, start it, `waitContainer`, then `removeContainer` (always, in `finally`). Docker copies the image's `/opt/gm-clis` into the empty volume on that first mount. If the exit code is not 0, `removeVolume(name)` and throw `Error(\`filling ${name} failed (exit <code>)\`)`.
- **GOTCHA**: do not use the `nocopy` volume option: the copy-on-first-mount is the point.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-run.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** replace `SANDBOX_PATH` with `export const DEFAULT_IMAGE_PATH = "/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"` and `export function sandboxPath(imagePath?: string): string` = `\`/opt/gm-tools/bin:/opt/gm-clis/bin:${imagePath || DEFAULT_IMAGE_PATH}\``. `sandboxEnv`'s params get `imagePath?: string` and push `PATH=${sandboxPath(p.imagePath)}`. Update the comment (Docker does not expand `$PATH` in `Env`, so the image's PATH is read with image inspect).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- sandbox-run`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-tools.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** delete `PROVIDER_CLIS`, `findOnPath`, `packageRootOf`, `isBroadDir`, `execLine`, `copyProviderClis` and every import only they used (`accessSync`, `constants`, `os`, …). `fillTools` options lose `pathEnv`; it copies the engine and writes `bin/graph-execution` only; the swapped entries are `["graph-execution", "bin"]`, and it removes `<dir>/lib` (old CLI copies) with `rm(..., { recursive: true, force: true })`. Update the file's header comment: the provider CLIs now come from the `gm-clis` volume (`sandbox-image.ts`). Keep `copyTree`, `copyDependencies`, `writeWrapper` (still used for the engine).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- sandbox-tools`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** `SandboxStatus` gets `building?: boolean`. Export `interface SandboxBuild { state: "idle" | "building" | "ready" | "failed"; step?: "clis" | "image"; startedAt?: string; finishedAt?: string; error?: string; log: string[] }`.
- **IMPLEMENT** fields `private build: SandboxBuild = { state: "idle", log: [] }`, `private building?: Promise<void>`, `private clisVolume?: string`, `private image?: string` (the built default image; in this slice set from what `buildImages` returns). Method `buildState(): SandboxBuild` returns a copy (log copied).
- **IMPLEMENT** `protected async buildImages(opts: { force?: boolean; clis?: boolean; onLine: (l: string) => void; onStep: (s: "clis" | "image") => void }): Promise<{ image: string; clisVolume: string }>` — `onStep("clis")`; `const cli = await ensureCliImage(this.docker, GM_VERSION, { force: opts.force && opts.clis, onLine })`; `const clisVolume = await ensureClisVolume(this.docker, cli)`; then remove other `gm-clis-*` volumes: `for (const v of await listVolumes(CLIS_LABEL)) if (v.Name !== clisVolume) await removeVolume(v.Name)` (in-use ones are kept by Docker's 409). Return `{ image: <today's default: config.sandboxImage ?? this.self?.Config.Image ?? DEFAULT_SANDBOX_IMAGE>, clisVolume }`.
- **IMPLEMENT** `ensureImages(opts: { force?: boolean; clis?: boolean } = {}): Promise<void>` — if `this.building` return it. Else set `build = { state: "building", startedAt: now, log: [] }`, run `buildImages({ ...opts, onLine: l => push (keep the last 1000 lines), onStep: s => build.step = s })`; on success: `this.image`, `this.clisVolume`, `build.state = "ready"`, `finishedAt`, and `this.last = { status: { available: true, building: false, defaultImage: this.defaultImage() }, at: Date.now() }`; on error: `build.state = "failed"`, `build.error = message`, `this.last = { status: { available: false, building: false, reason: \`the sandbox image build failed: ${message}\` }, at: Date.now() }`. Always clear `this.building` in `finally`. Never rejects.
- **IMPLEMENT** `doInit()`: after `prepareTools()` succeeded and before `reconcile()` (keep `reconcile()` running in every path that ran it before):
  - if `build.state === "failed"` → return `{ available: false, building: false, reason: \`the sandbox image build failed: ${build.error}\` }` (no automatic rebuild after a failure; the user saves the recipe or presses Rebuild — later slices).
  - else `const p = this.ensureImages()`; wait for `p` or `INIT_WAIT_MS = 500` ms, whichever first. If the build is now `ready` → `{ available: true, building: false, defaultImage: this.defaultImage() }`; if it failed → the failed status; else `{ available: false, building: true, reason: "building the sandbox image" }`.
- **IMPLEMENT** `status()`: before the cached logic, `if (this.build.state === "building") return { available: false, building: true, reason: "building the sandbox image" }`; and treat a cached status with `building: true` as stale (re-run `init()`), so the first status after the build is the real one.
- **IMPLEMENT** `defaultImage()`: `this.image ?? <today's expression>`.
- **IMPLEMENT** `clisMount(): ToolsMount | undefined` → `{ Type: "volume", Source: this.clisVolume, Target: CLIS_TARGET, ReadOnly: true }` when set.
- **IMPLEMENT** `start()`: first, `if (this.build.state === "building") throw new SandboxError(409, "the sandbox image is building; try again when it is ready")` (before the generic unavailable check). After the tools check: `const clis = this.clisMount(); if (!clis) throw new SandboxError(400, "the sandbox tools are not ready")`. After the image is present (pulled if needed): `const imagePath = (await docker.inspectImage(image).catch(() => undefined))?.Config?.Env?.find((e) => e.startsWith("PATH="))?.slice(5)` and pass `imagePath` to `sandboxEnv`. Mounts: `[workspaceMount(...), tools, clis]`.
- **IMPLEMENT** remove `pathEnv` from the constructor options and from the `fillTools` call (update its doc comment).
- **IMPORTS**: `import { CLIS_LABEL, CLIS_TARGET, ensureCliImage, ensureClisVolume } from "./sandbox-image.js";`
- **GOTCHA**: `init()` must answer quickly even when the build takes minutes (the Start run drawer calls `status()` each time it opens). The 10 s retry of an unavailable status must never start a second build: `ensureImages` returns the running promise.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### UPDATE the tests

- **IMPLEMENT** everywhere `prepareTools` is stubbed (`sandbox.test.ts` `NoTools`, `routes/sandbox.test.ts`, `routes/runs.sandbox.test.ts`, `routes/internal.test.ts`, `routes/resume.test.ts`, `sandbox.docker.test.ts`, `sandbox.e2e.test.ts` and the "Sandboxes tools" describe of `sandbox-tools.test.ts`), also stub `buildImages`:
  ```ts
  vi.spyOn(Sandboxes.prototype as unknown as { buildImages: () => Promise<{ image: string; clisVolume: string }> }, "buildImages").mockImplementation(async function (
    this: { defaultImage(): string },
  ) {
    return { image: this.defaultImage(), clisVolume: "gm-clis-test" };
  });
  ```
  (in `NoTools`, override it the same way). Status expectations become `{ available: true, building: false, defaultImage: … }`; mount expectations gain `{ Type: "volume", Source: "gm-clis-test", Target: "/opt/gm-clis", ReadOnly: true }` after the tools mount; `sandbox-run.test.ts` expects `PATH=/opt/gm-tools/bin:/opt/gm-clis/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin` (the fake's images have that PATH). With real Docker (`sandbox.docker.test.ts`) a missing named volume is created empty on mount, which is fine for the fake provider.
- **IMPLEMENT** delete the "copyProviderClis" describe; add to "fillTools" that a tools folder with an old `lib/claude` loses it after `fillTools`, and `new Sandboxes({ config, store })` (no `pathEnv`).
- **IMPLEMENT** new tests in `src/server/sandbox-image.test.ts` against the fake (no stub of `buildImages`; `prepareTools` stubbed): (1) `ensureCliImage` builds once with the Dockerfile from `cliDockerfile()`, tag `gm-sandbox-clis:<v>`, label `gm.sandbox-image=1`, `nocache: false`; a second call builds nothing; `force: true` builds again with `nocache: true` and a new id. (2) `ensureClisVolume` creates `gm-clis-<12 hex>` with label `gm.clis=1`, runs and removes one fill container, and a second call creates nothing. (3) A `Sandboxes` with a fake started with `buildDelayMs: 1500`: `init()` resolves within 1 s with `{ available: false, building: true, reason: "building the sandbox image" }`; `start()` meanwhile rejects with `SandboxError` status 409 and the message above; after the build, `status()` is `available: true` and `clisMount()` names the volume; a second `init()` builds nothing (`fake.builds` length stays 1). (4) A failing build (spy `ensureCliImage` to throw, or a fake image build failure) makes `status()` `{ available: false, building: false, reason: "the sandbox image build failed: …" }` and `buildState().state === "failed"`; a later `status()` after `RETRY_MS` does not build again.
- **PATTERN**: `src/server/sandbox.test.ts` (fake per test, `HOSTNAME` saved/restored, `testConfig(dir, overrides)`).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No provider CLI is copied from graph-manager's PATH; `<toolsDir>/lib` does not exist after `fillTools`.
- [ ] On init, graph-manager builds `gm-sandbox-clis:<version>` (Dockerfile as above, label `gm.sandbox-image=1`) only when missing, and fills `gm-clis-<id12>` (label `gm.clis=1`) only when missing; other `gm-clis-*` volumes are removed unless in use.
- [ ] `init()`/`status()` answer within ~0.5 s with `{ available: false, building: true, reason: "building the sandbox image" }` while the build runs, then `{ available: true, building: false, defaultImage }`.
- [ ] A sandboxed start during the build answers 409 `the sandbox image is building; try again when it is ready` (POST /api/runs/:ws and the internal sandbox-runs route).
- [ ] A failed build gives `available: false` with reason `the sandbox image build failed: <message>` and is not retried automatically.
- [ ] Every sandbox container mounts `{ Type: "volume", Source: "gm-clis-<id12>", Target: "/opt/gm-clis", ReadOnly: true }`, and its `PATH` is `/opt/gm-tools/bin:/opt/gm-clis/bin:` + its image's PATH.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- sandbox
npm test -w graph-manager
```
